instruction: I want VLC to always stay on top of other windows when playing videos. Can you configure VLC Media Player to remain on top of all other applications?

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because verifying the 'always on top' window behavior requires checking window management properties that are not reliably accessible through the current evaluation framework. The setting exists in VLC preferences but cannot be programmatically verified in the OSWorld environment.

llm_judge_reasons: The 'infeasible' evaluator is semantically correct for this task
Window 'always on top' behavior requires checking window management properties (X11 hints, window manager state) that are not available in the OSWorld evaluation framework
Existing VLC metrics (is_vlc_playing, is_vlc_fullscreen, check_qt_*) cannot verify window layering behavior
The task correctly acknowledges framework limitations - verification would require system-level window management APIs not present in the current getter/metric functions
The explanation in metadata accurately describes why the task cannot be verified
